messages.content: Identify which macro phase numbers may be counted in full toward the source-emphasized majority sequence. Return JSON only.

SOURCE EMPHASIS:
"The majority of the film is Amy killing zombies as they try and attack her."

ARC:
Phase 1, Beat 1: Amy cooks breakfast.
Phase 2, Beats 2-3: zombie breaks in; Amy gets the kids safe and locks the door.
Phase 3, Beats 4-8:
- Beat 4: Amy retrieves and equips her pistol and katana before combat begins.
- Beats 5-7: Amy fights and kills attacking zombies.
- Beat 8: Amy kills the last zombie and immediately lets her kids out.

COUNTING RULE:
A returned phase will have its ENTIRE beat_start..beat_end span counted by Python.
Therefore return a phase ONLY when every beat in that phase materially belongs to the emphasized ongoing sequence, except that the final beat may also include immediate terminal aftermath/resolution.
Standalone preparation BEFORE the emphasized process begins does not belong and makes a mixed phase unsafe to count in full. Do not count only the main idea of a mixed phase.

Return exactly {"matching_phases":[...]}.
